subject: Payment timetable check & split-pay options for INV-7218
messages:
From: Maya Singh <accounts-payable@greenwave.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment timing & split for invoice INV-7218

Kimberly / Laura,

Thanks — attached is invoice INV-7218 and our PO (GreenWave_PO_3321). We ran this through our AP queue and have two constraints: cashflow this week (can release up to ~60% by wire/ACH today) and card spend limits for the month.

Options we can do today:
- Wire (Fed/Wire) or ACH for up to 60% of the invoice immediately (bank details required)
- Pay remaining via virtual card or on net-30 depending on approval

Can you confirm:
1) Bank account details for Redwood (routing/account name) and any invoice remittance reference we should include.
2) If you require a VAT form or tax residency certificate from our side to clear EU/UK tax withholding — we can share that shortly.

If you prefer a single method we can try to pull the full payment but it would be scheduled on Tuesday morning. Please advise the preferred split/routing and timing; we want to avoid an AP hold.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Accounts Payable | GreenWave Inc.
attachments: INV-7218.pdf, GreenWave_PO_3321.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <accounts-payable@greenwave.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment timing & split for invoice INV-7218

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and for attaching the PO.

We can accept either ACH or wire. Preferred flow: ACH to our US account for non-urgent volumes (faster clearing in many banks), wire for same-day large clears. If you can do 60% today by wire/ACH that works; we can accept the remainder by virtual card or as a 30-day balance — whichever minimizes fees on your side.

Bank details (for wire):
- Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Bank: Meridian Bank (US)
- Account: 123456789
- Routing: 071000013
- Reference: INV-7218 / GreenWave PO 3321

On VAT: if you are in the US this is not needed; if the payment will be routed from an EU entity please send the VAT/residency certificate and we will confirm withholding should not apply. Laura — can you confirm whether we need to record this against the EU subsidiary?

Ben — looping you for collections guidance if they ask to split and then request proof of funds.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0134

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment timing & split for invoice INV-7218

Kim / Laura — quick internal thought: if GreenWave can release 60% today we should accept wire/ACH immediately and invoice remaining 40% as a virtual-card charge. Two asks to include in our reply so AP has everything to act:
1) Request a payment trace/P.O.F. for the wire (screenshot or bank reference) once it is initiated. We can mark as received at the time of originating transaction.
2) If they choose virtual card for balance, ask for the total dollar amount to be authorized and whether there is a split fee they want us to absorb (we can offer to split fees up to $X).

I'll prepare a one-line DocuSign authorization for the split arrangement (keeps procurement happy). Draft link: https://app.docusign.com/templates/ABCD-1234-sign — Kimberly, feel free to send directly to Maya with the bank details block and note about VAT certificate if needed.

Ben Carter
Collections Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Michael Chan <michael.chan@greenwave.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@greenwave.io, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment timing & split for invoice INV-7218

Hi Kimberly / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We can do the following:
- Wire 60% of INV-7218 today via ACH (expected to post same day) using the bank details you provided. We will send a wire trace once submitted.
- Remaining 40% to be charged via virtual card today as well (we will authorize the card and provide the transaction ID).

Attached is a small confirmation stub from AP showing the intended split (payment_stub.pdf). We do not need a DocuSign for this — our procurement team approved the split via email. For VAT: payment originates from GreenWave US entity so no withholding applies.

We should be good to proceed — we will submit the ACH now and follow with the virtual card authorization in the afternoon.

Best,
Michael Chan
Senior AP Manager | GreenWave Inc.
